name: host CPU saturation — idle < 5% sustained 30 min
description: livespec-3lev.1 host-usability safety net. system.cpu.utilization.idle carries the SUM of per-core idle fractions (~= idle-core count) on the 18-core host, so 0.9 = 5% x 18 cores. RE-DERIVE the threshold on hardware change (0.05 x core count). Validated against 9 days of sysstat history: fires exactly once (the 2026-07-18 load-270 incident), zero false positives.
